description:
The stories of the last 24 hours in rank order, run again hourly (`as_of`, `window_hours`): each story's
rank, our title, its score (0-1: the edition's perspective, its mains pulled by the edition's stakes), `mains`
(the main at the edition's home and at the world, the honest pair), its outlets, our story page, and a piece
to ask `why` about. With `country`, the stories about it, and a note when we read few of its outlets.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, such as FI: only the stories about that country.
